note: Afghanistan's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: UN sanctions
spirits.description: Security Council Resolution 1267, adopted on 15 October 1999, put sanctions on the Taliban and al-Qaida.

source.title: Wikipedia: United Nations Security Council Resolution 1267

spirits.name: A divided country
spirits.description: The Taliban rule most of the country; the Northern Alliance holds the north-east and keeps the UN seat.

spirits.name: Opium economy
spirits.description: Afghanistan produces most of the world's illicit opium.

spirits.name: International aid
spirits.description: Donors pay for much of the state budget and the army.

spirits.name: Insurgency
spirits.description: An insurgency fights the government in the south and east.

spirits.name: A legal economy
spirits.description: Farmers grow other crops and the state collects taxes.
